t2.title: Video games a waste of time or can they be beneficial
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Are video games a waste of time or can they be beneficial?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Professional Cleaning: Investment or Expense?

This is a question many households debate. Having recently started using professional cleaning, I believe it's a worthwhile investment for many people.

Firstly, time is money. For working professionals, the hours spent cleaning could be used for income-generating activities or quality time with family.

Moreover, professional cleaners deliver superior results. They have the equipment, products, and expertise to clean more effectively than most homeowners.

Additionally, regular cleaning maintains your home's condition, potentially saving money on repairs and extending the life of furnishings.

However, it's not for everyone. Those on tight budgets or who enjoy cleaning may find it unnecessary.

Ultimately, the value depends on your personal circumstances – income, available time, and priorities. For dual-income families or busy professionals, the peace of mind and time saved often justify the cost.

What's your experience with cleaning services?
t2.sampleA1:
Hi SparkleClean,


Clean good. I like clean. Thank you.


Bye
t2.sampleA2:
Dear SparkleClean,


I liked the cleaning. It was good. The people were nice and they cleaned my house well. The booking was easy, and I think it is good. I want you to clean my windows next time, because they are dirty. Thank you.


Thanks,


Doston Karimov
t2.sampleB1:
Dear SparkleClean Management,


I am writing to give you some feedback about the cleaning service I recently used. Overall, I was quite happy with the service. The team arrived on time and did a thorough job cleaning my apartment. The booking process was also very straightforward and convenient.


However, there are a couple of things I think you could improve. Firstly, I would like it if the cleaning team used more environmentally friendly cleaning products. I am also wondering if you could offer a service where they organize things a bit, as well as just cleaning. For example, tidying up books and papers.


In conclusion, I was satisfied with SparkleClean and would recommend it to others. I hope my suggestions are helpful.


Sincerely,
Doston Karimov
t2.sampleB2:
Video Games: A Waste of Time or a Hidden Benefit?

Ask any parent and they'll probably tell you that video games rot your brain. But is that really the whole story? I'd argue that, played in moderation, games can actually do us a world of good.

First of all, games are far from mindless. Many titles require players to think on their feet, solve tricky puzzles and plan several steps ahead. For example, strategy games push you to weigh up options and make quick decisions. These are exactly the kind of problem-solving skills that come in handy at school and work.

What's more, online games bring people together. Friends who live miles apart can team up, chat and cooperate, which helps build social skills and can even teach teamwork that carries over into real life.

Of course, everything has its downside. Spending hours glued to a screen can harm your health and eat into study time, so striking a balance is essential.

All in all, video games are not the villain they're made out to be. Used wisely, they can be both fun and genuinely rewarding.
t2.uzSample:
Professional tozalash: Investitsiyami yoki xarajat?

Bu ko'plab oilalar bahslashadigan savol. Yaqinda professional tozalashdan foydalana boshlaganimdan so'ng, menimcha, bu ko'pchilik uchun arzirli investitsiya.

Birinchidan, vaqt - pul. Ishlaydigan mutaxassislar uchun tozalashga sarflangan soatlar daromad keltiradigan faoliyat yoki oila bilan sifatli vaqt o'tkazish uchun ishlatilishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, professional tozalovchilar yuqori natijalarni taqdim etadilar. Ularda ko'pchilik uy egalariga qaraganda samaraliroq tozalash uchun uskunalar, mahsulotlar va tajriba mavjud.

Qolaversa, muntazam tozalash uyingizning holatini saqlaydi, bu esa ta'mirlashga pul tejashga va jihozlarning xizmat qilish muddatini uzaytirishga yordam beradi.

Biroq, bu hamma uchun emas. Qattiq byudjetga ega bo'lganlar yoki tozalashdan zavqlanadiganlar uchun bu keraksiz bo'lishi mumkin.

Oxir oqibat, qiymat sizning shaxsiy holatlaringizga - daromadingiz, mavjud vaqtingiz va ustuvorliklaringizga bog'liq. Ikki daromadli oilalar yoki band mutaxassislar uchun xotirjamlik va tejashgan vaqt ko'pincha xarajatni oqlaydi.

Tozalash xizmatlari bilan tajribangiz qanday?
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom SparkleClean,


Tozalik yaxshi. Menga tozalik yoqadi. Rahmat.


Xayr
t2.uzSampleA2:
Hurmatli SparkleClean,


Menga tozalash yoqdi. Yaxshi bo'ldi. Odamlar yaxshi edi va ular uyimni yaxshi tozalashdi. Bron qilish oson bo'ldi va menimcha bu yaxshi. Keyingi safar derazalarimni tozalashingizni xohlayman, chunki ular iflos. Rahmat.


Rahmat bilan,


Doston Karimov
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli SparkleClean rahbariyati,


Men yaqinda foydalangan tozalash xizmati haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, men xizmatdan juda mamnun bo'ldim. Jamoa o'z vaqtida keldi va kvartiramni puxta tozaladi. Buyurtma berish jarayoni ham juda sodda va qulay edi.


Biroq, siz yaxshilashingiz mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta narsa bor deb o'ylayman. Birinchidan, tozalash jamoasi ekologik toza tozalash vositalaridan ko'proq foydalanishini xohlardim. Shuningdek, ular nafaqat tozalash, balki narsalarni biroz tartibga soladigan xizmatni taklif qila olasizmi, deb o'ylayman. Masalan, kitoblar va qog'ozlarni tartibga keltirish.


Xulosa qilib aytganda, men SparkleClean'dan qoniqdim va uni boshqalarga tavsiya qilaman. Umid qilamanki, mening takliflarim foydali bo'ladi.


Hurmat bilan,
Doston Karimov
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli SparkleClean rahbariyati,


Men yaqinda olgan tozalash xizmatiga oid fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, men tozalash guruhining samaradorligi va puxtaligidan ta'sirlandim. Buyurtma berish jarayoni juda oson kechdi va uchrashuvga qadar bo'lgan tezkor aloqani qadrladim.


Tozalashning o'zi maqtovga sazovor bo'lsa-da, xizmatni yaxshilash bo'yicha bir nechta takliflarim bor. Birinchidan, pechni tozalash va muzlatgichni tartibga solish kabi xizmatlarni o'z ichiga olgan chuqur tozalash paketini taklif qilish qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'ladi. Ikkinchidan, mijozlarga tozalash vositalari brendlarini, ayniqsa ekologik toza yoki gipoallergen variantlarni tanlash imkoniyatini berish mijozlarning kengroq xohishlariga mos keladi. Bundan tashqari, mijozlar uchun aniq ko'rsatmalar berish yoki uyning ma'lum joylariga ustuvor ahamiyat berish tizimi xizmatning shaxsiy jihatini yaxshilaydi.


Ushbu kichik takliflarga qaramay, men ko'rsatilgan xizmatdan juda mamnun bo'ldim va SparkleClean-ni ishonchli va samarali uy tozalash yechimini izlayotgan boshqalarga tavsiya qilishdan tortinmayman.


Hurmat bilan,
Doston Karimov

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is thinking about hiring a cleaning service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! I finally tried a cleaning service and it was totally worth it! They did a thorough job and the house looks spotless. The team was really professional too! You should definitely give it a try!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Nodirbek,
I have clean house. Good!
Cleaners good. You try?
Bye!
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Nodirbek,
I used a cleaning service. It was good! My house is clean now. The people were nice and they cleaned everything. But it was expensive. You should try it, but ask about the price first.
Bye!
t11.sampleB1:
Hi Nodirbek,
You know how I was thinking about getting a cleaning service? Well, I finally did it! It was actually pretty good. They cleaned the house really well, and it saved me a lot of time. I think you should consider it too, especially because you're so busy. However, it wasn't cheap, so maybe get a quote first.
Talk soon!
t11.sampleB2:
Hi Nodirbek,

Guess what — I finally bit the bullet and hired that cleaning service we talked about! Honestly, it was worth every penny. The team turned up on time, did a thorough job, and now the flat looks absolutely spotless. You should definitely give it a go — I reckon you'd love it too!

Speak soon,
Bekzod Aliyev
t11.uzSample:
Salom!

Men nihoyat tozalash xizmatidan foydalanib ko'rdim va bu butunlay arziydi! Ular juda puxta ish qilishdi va uy juda toza ko'rinadi. Jamoa ham juda professional edi!

Siz ham albatta urinib ko'rishingiz kerak!
t11.uzSampleA1:

Mening uyim toza. Yaxshi!
Tozalovchilar yaxshi. Sen urinib ko'rasanmi?

t11.uzSampleA2:
Salom, Nodirbek,
Men tozalash xizmatidan foydalandim. Yaxshi bo'ldi! Uyim hozir toza. Odamlar yaxshi edi va ular hamma narsani tozalashdi. Lekin qimmat edi. Siz ham urinib ko'ring, lekin avval narxini so'rang.
Xayr!
t11.uzSampleB1:
Salom, Nodirbek,
Esimda bo'lsa, men tozalash xizmatini olish haqida o'ylayotgan edim-a? Xullas, men nihoyatda oldim! Rostini aytsam, juda yaxshi bo'ldi. Ular uyni juda yaxshi tozalashdi va bu menga juda ko'p vaqtni tejadi. Menimcha, sen ham buni ko'rib chiqishing kerak, ayniqsa sen juda band bo'lganing uchun. Biroq, bu arzon emas edi, shuning uchun avval narxini bilib ko'rishing mumkin.
Tez orada gaplashamiz!
t11.uzSampleB2:
Salom Nodirbek,
Esimda bo'lsa, tozalash xizmatlari haqida gaplashgan edik? Men nihoyat risk qildim va bittasini yolladim, va rostini aytsam, buni oldinroq qilmaganim uchun o'zimni koyiyapman! Uy yaraqlab turibdi va bu mening dam olish kunlarimning juda ko'p qismini bo'shatdi. O'ylashimcha, hozirda qanchalik ko'p narsani bir vaqtda bajarayotganingizni hisobga olsak, bu haqda jiddiy o'ylab ko'rishingiz kerak. Lekin tadqiqotlaringizni o'tkazing – ba'zi kompaniyalar boshqalaridan yaxshiroq. Agar qiziqsangiz, men foydalangan kompaniyani tavsiya qilishdan xursand bo'lardim. Faqat xarajatga tayyor bo'ling – bu, albatta, sarmoya.
Nima deb o'ylaysiz, menga xabar bering!
Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Doston Karimov

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the cleaning service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear SparkleClean Management,

I am writing to share my feedback after using your cleaning service for the first time.

Firstly, I was extremely impressed by the quality of work. Your team was thorough, paying attention to areas I often overlook.

Moreover, the booking process was remarkably simple and convenient. The online system made scheduling effortless.

However, I have some suggestions. Offering eco-friendly cleaning products as an option would attract environmentally conscious customers.

Additionally, a subscription package with discounted rates for regular customers would be highly beneficial.

Furthermore, adding laundry services could make your offering more comprehensive.

Thank you for the excellent service.

Best regards,
A Satisfied Customer
t12.sampleA1:
Hi SparkleClean,
I like clean. My house is clean now. Good job!
Bye
t12.sampleA2:
Dear SparkleClean,
Thank you for cleaning my house. It was good. The people were nice and they cleaned well. But it was expensive. I think you should be cheaper. And maybe clean the windows too. Thank you.
From, Doston Karimov
t12.sampleB1:
Dear SparkleClean Management,

I am writing to tell you about my experience with your cleaning service. Overall, I was quite happy with the cleaning. The team arrived on time and did a good job cleaning my house. The booking was also easy to do online, which was very convenient.

However, I think you could improve a few things. For example, it would be good if you offered cleaning on weekends. Also, I think you should have different packages for different sized houses. This would make it easier to choose the right option.

Thank you for your service.

Sincerely,
Doston Karimov
t12.sampleB2:
Dear SparkleClean Management,

I am writing to share some feedback following my first experience with your cleaning service.

On the whole, I was thoroughly impressed with the standard of work. Your team arrived right on time and paid close attention to detail, reaching areas I usually overlook, such as behind the furniture. The booking process was remarkably straightforward as well, and the online system made scheduling effortless.

That said, I would like to put forward a couple of suggestions. Introducing eco-friendly products as an option would appeal to environmentally conscious customers. In addition, a loyalty scheme with discounted rates for regular clients would help you stand out from competitors.

Overall, I was delighted with the service and will happily recommend you to friends.

Yours faithfully,
Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli SparkleClean rahbariyati,

Sizning tozalash xizmatingizdan birinchi marta foydalanganimdan so'ng o'z fikrlarimni bildirmoqchiman.

Avvalo, ish sifatidan juda ta'sirlandim. Sizning jamoangiz juda puxta ish olib bordi va men ko'pincha e'tibordan chetda qoldiradigan joylarga ham e'tibor qaratdi.

Bundan tashqari, buyurtma berish jarayoni juda oddiy va qulay edi. Onlayn tizim rejalashtirishni osonlashtirdi.

Biroq, mening ba'zi takliflarim bor. Atrof-muhitga befarq bo'lmagan mijozlarni jalb qilish uchun ekologik toza tozalash mahsulotlarini taklif qilish yaxshi bo'lardi.

Qolaversa, doimiy mijozlar uchun chegirmali narxlarni o'z ichiga olgan obuna paketini taklif qilish juda foydali bo'lardi.

Bundan tashqari, kir yuvish xizmatlarini qo'shish sizning taklifingizni yanada to'liqroq qilishi mumkin edi.

Ajoyib xizmat uchun rahmat.

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Xursand mijoz

Hurmatli SparkleClean,

Kimdan, Doston Karimov
t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli SparkleClean rahbariyati,

Sizga tozalash xizmatlaringiz bilan bog'liq tajribam haqida xabar bermoqchiman. Umuman olganda, tozalashdan juda mamnun bo'ldim. Jamoa o'z vaqtida keldi va uyimni yaxshi tozaladi. Onlayn orqali buyurtma berish ham oson bo'ldi, bu juda qulay edi.

Biroq, menimcha, siz bir nechta narsani yaxshilashingiz mumkin. Misol uchun, agar dam olish kunlari tozalashni taklif qilsangiz yaxshi bo'lardi. Shuningdek, turli o'lchamdagi uylar uchun turli paketlaringiz bo'lishi kerak deb o'ylayman. Bu to'g'ri variantni tanlashni osonlashtiradi.

Xizmatlaringiz uchun rahmat.

Hurmat bilan,
Doston Karimov
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli SparkleClean rahbariyati,

Sizning tozalash xizmatingiz bilan yaqinda bo'lgan tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Shuni aytishim kerakki, ko'rsatilgan tozalash standartidan umuman olganda mamnun bo'ldim. Jamoa o'z vaqtida keldi, samarali ishladi va ayniqsa oshxona va hammomlarda maqtovga sazovor e'tibor ko'rsatdi.

Onlayn bron qilish tizimi ham sodda va foydalanuvchilar uchun qulay edi, bu meni xursand qildi. Biroq, xizmatingizni yaxshilash mumkin bo'lgan sohalar bor deb hisoblayman. Xususan, doimiy mijozlarni taqdirlash uchun sodiqlik dasturini joriy etishni ko'rib chiqishni taklif qilaman. Bundan tashqari, mebelni tozalash yoki gilamdagi dog'larni yo'qotish kabi ko'proq ixtisoslashgan tozalash xizmatlarini taklif qilish sizning jozibadorligingizni kengaytirishi va turli xil ehtiyojlarni qondirishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, ishlatiladigan aniq mahsulotlar haqida aniqroq ma'lumot berish foydali bo'ladi, ayniqsa allergiyasi yoki sezgirligi bo'lgan mijozlar uchun. Umuman olganda, men xizmatdan mamnunman va bu masalalarni hal qilish mijozlar tajribasini yanada oshirishi mumkinligiga ishonaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Doston Karimov
